title: Software Engineering for AI-driven Building Operation
abstract: arXiv:2608.16237v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Building operations are energy-inefficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI)-driven control systems promise benefits through optimization and predictive control, but deploying them in real buildings reveals a significant software engineering (SE) challenge. SE for AI practices assume digital environments where failures mean poor user experience. Buildings are different. A bad control decision wastes energy irreversibly, violates occupant comfort, or accelerates equipment wear. Although actual safety-critical failures are rare, as real building automation systems are inherently fault-tolerant, the physical and lasting nature of even minor failures fundamentally changes SE4AI requirements. translated_title: 面向AI驱动建筑运维的软件工程
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16237v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：建筑运维能效低下。人工智能（AI）驱动的控制系统通过优化和预测控制有望带来益处，但在实际建筑中部署它们揭示了显著的软件工程（SE）挑战。面向AI的软件工程实践假设数字环境中的故障意味着糟糕的用户体验，但建筑则不同。一个糟糕的控制决策会不可逆地浪费能源、损害居住者舒适度，或加速设备磨损。尽管实际的安全关键故障很少见，因为真实建筑自动化系统本质上是容错的，但即使是轻微故障的物理性和持久性也从根本上改变了SE4AI的要求。基于土木工程和计算机科学两个跨学科研究项目，这些项目旨在实现建筑运维的AI驱动优化，我们识别了目前阻碍AI成功部署的SE4AI中缺失的视角。
tldr: 本文指出传统SE4AI方法忽略建筑物理环境的特殊性，强调AI驱动建筑运维中即使是微小控制故障也具有不可逆影响，需重新定义软件工程要求。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies that traditional SE4AI methods overlook the physical uniqueness of buildings, emphasizing that even minor control failures in AI-driven building operations have irreversible impacts, necessitating a redefinition of software engineering requirements.
